description.en: Metasequoia-inspired preserved leafy branch organ only, with explicit opposite lateral attachments and paired/decussate small flat leaves separated by readable node intervals. Specimen display, no full tree/crown, roots or unsupported associated reproductive organs. Thickness, compression, leaf counts and nominal span are artistic, not measured fossil data.
description.zh: Metasequoia启发保存叶枝器官，明确对生侧枝、小扁叶成对并交互排列，节点间隔清楚。仅标本展示，不造完整树冠、根或未关联生殖器官；厚度、压缩程度、叶数和名义展宽属艺术选择，非化石测量。

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed original stylized-inspired static teaching art. Palette, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
